Requirements and acceptance traceability

This page maps the project to the attached 15-page COMS3011A brief, sections 2.1–2.2, and the project-specific Tutor Management System brief. It complements the 20 weighted final criteria; documentation coverage is not an awarded grade.

Requirements shared by every project

Requirement Tutor MX implementation and evidence Inspect
Git version control Official Gitea repository, reviewed Member branches, sequential later-sprint merges and deployment mirror Git methodology · Work tracker
Responsiveness and accessibility Role-aware responsive screens, Compact/list alternatives, focus states and Lighthouse evidence; recorded contrast/overflow limitations remain Frontend · Testing
CI/CD Application quality/coverage/migration gates in Gitea; reviewed-source release to Render/Cloudflare; separate GitHub Pages workflow for this site Deployment · Testing
Separate frontend and backend React/Vite browser UI calls the independently deployed Express HTTP API Architecture · Backend
Handwritten API 120 registered Express operations; Prisma manages persistence, not generated public HTTP endpoints API catalogue · Route source
Established authentication and security Auth0 sign-up/sign-in/password reset/account deletion; server role/ownership checks; Master approval for lecturers Security · Account and role journeys
Relevant external API South African public holidays via the Nager.Date backend adapter, with timeout/cache/fallback Integration
Public documentation website Static React/Markdown build on GitHub Pages, readable without a documentation account; private Gitea evidence is labelled Site guide · Sources

Tutor Management System feature tiers

The tiers are cumulative. The final-source register documents these capabilities; a separate production acceptance record is needed to establish how every feature behaves for real users.

Tier Required capability Implementation trail
Basic Courses, Tutors, course marks, busy times and weekly-hour limits Database models · Feature register
Basic One allocation board with immediate marks/clash/capacity feedback Frontend task paths · Allocation contracts
Basic Work logs, timesheet submission/sign-off, excuses and Student volunteering All-role walkthrough · Backend rules
Basic A distinct and understandable entry for Student, Tutor and Organiser Navigation and first use
Intermediate Tutor ranking, bulk assignments, shortages and recorded override reasons Organiser features · Sprint 3
Intermediate Timetable import, recurring exceptions and academic terms Shared scheduling · Schema
Intermediate Timesheet corrections/disputes, reminders and payroll export Tutor workflow · Backend
Intermediate Posted overflow work, approved volunteer claims and assignment notifications Feature register · API
Intermediate Course hours, budget/spend and workload distribution Organiser features · Sprint 3
Intermediate Guided onboarding, global search, keyboard navigation and bulk actions Frontend · Testing
Advanced Whole-school proposals balancing objectives, preserving locks and explaining choices Final release · Member 6 acceptance record
Advanced Multi-Organiser presence and conflict-aware editing Scenario features · Backend
Advanced Side-by-side drafts, comparison and explicit publish Role walkthrough · Scenario API
Advanced Tutor swaps with eligibility checks and approval Tutor journey · API
Advanced Recorded changes and restoration of an earlier allocation state Audit and restore · Final release

Student tutoring bookings and Student sick notes extend the original brief through the later handbook and stakeholder decisions. These additions do not replace any of the original allocation or administration requirements.
